justification: Although some applicants raise Article 11 complaints (e.g., dispersal of public assemblies, convictions for calls to participate in events), the judgment's merits analysis is primarily structured around Article 5 § 1 and other well-established case-law complaints, with Article 11 findings bundled into a generic multi-article paragraph without a standalone, unified Article 11 merits analysis or a discrete Article 11 violation finding in the operative provisions.
